text: Hamas death squads perform a summary execution.

Following the ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas, and the IDF withdrawal from sections of Gaza, Hamas begins rounding up in Gazan opposition clans and executes them in public to regain its grip on the Strip.
Hamas just published horrific videos of shooting 'collaborators,' boasting that 'their legs were cut off.'
Hamas militias in Gaza demolished market stalls and destroyed the tents of displaced civilians for refusing to pay Hamas-imposed taxes.
Women living under Hamas rule in Gaza describe to the Mail how they are sexually abused by the terror group's fighters and forced to have sex in return for food aid.

More than 40 Hamas militants attacked the Al Wahidi family house in the Al Remal neighborhood of Gaza city, attacked and beat everyone they saw inside the house with sticks and batons, including women and children, and stole many properties from the house before they fled. Many were wounded and were sent to the hospital. The story is happening because of a reported disagreement between one of the family members and Hamas.
A New York Post headline reports Ahmed Fouad Alkhatib’s allegation that Hamas stored infant formula and nutritional supplies instead of distributing them.
Fathi Hammad praises using women, children and elderly people as human shields in an Al-Aqsa TV appearance.
Eitan Fischberger reports that Hamas killed Gaza Humanitarian Foundation aid workers and challenges humanitarian organizations’ silence about attacks on Palestinians delivering food.
Gaza channels report that Hamas kidnapped and tortured Jabalia shopkeeper Mahmoud Khalla to death, depicting Hamas’s violence against Gazans.
Palestinian Authority reporting says Hamas is using schools and hospitals to interrogate Gazan opponents and rebuild its control during the ceasefire.
Posts document Hamas’s renewed crackdown after the October 2025 ceasefire, including public executions and torture of Palestinians; Gazans appeal for outside intervention.
Gazan dissident Hamza Howidy reports that Hamas is holding missing influencers and activists inside Nasser and Al-Aqsa hospitals as makeshift detention and interrogation sites.

Gazan dissident Hamza Howidy reports that Hamas executed a mother and her two young sons after their father joined an anti-Hamas militia; Alex Gideon criticizes the lack of attention to Hamas killing Palestinian children.
